historicalAttempts.claimBoundary: The route deliberately redacted the internal exception and the retained report stored neither the route stage nor a stack trace.

historicalAttempts.knownMeaning: The final exact result did not have final, ownership and vault all true.

historicalEvidenceConflict.resolution: The historical observations are preserved as originally recorded; no unsupported exact sub-error is invented.

provenLifecycleDefects.evidence: Before the patch one process logged both an insecure default AEGIS secret and the configured AEGIS_SECRET. After the patch every qualifying run logged only the configured secret.
provenLifecycleDefects.effect: Different module evaluation contexts could observe different secret state during the same test, making physical exact verification non-repeatable.

provenLifecycleDefects.evidence: The old finally block called a reset helper whose shutdown promise was discarded and then directly released process leases a second time.
provenLifecycleDefects.effect: Worker, SQLite lease and temporary-root teardown order was nondeterministic after a pass or an early failure.

changes: Load project modules only after the frozen test environment is fully initialized.
Await the existing canonical Live runtime shutdown helper exactly once in the finally block.
Clean the scoped temporary root even when fixture or server setup fails before the main test try/finally block.

nonQualifyingOperatorInvocations.reasonExcluded: The explicit FFmpeg environment variable was misnamed, so the frozen runtime precondition was absent.
The three canonical Live worker environment variables were absent, so this was not the frozen product runtime environment.
nonQualifyingOperatorInvocations.observation: The start request failed closed with HTTP 503 before watermarking.

earlySetupCleanupNegative.condition: Explicit FFmpeg environment deliberately absent after the cleanup patch.

releaseDecision.reason: The exact historical sub-errors were not retained and are not reconstructed. The owner accepted the proven lifecycle defects, narrow fix and 3/3 frozen repeatability result as closing the current release gap.
